messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident PD-8721 fired for tenant=zenit — alert=reserved_capacity_exceeded, affected=dedicated-pool-zenit-3, symptom=tail-latency spike + 429s. Links: https://pd.redwood/pd/PD-8721
Sam (oncall): Acked PD-8721 — I'm taking it. Checking dashboards + recent deploys. Any CS contact? :eyes:
pagerduty: PD-8721 acknowledged by Sam (oncall) at 21:12 UTC
Anya (CS - Zenit): We're seeing multiple customer dashboards with degraded realtime generation latency. Zenit reports user-facing errors since ~20:50 UTC. They asked for ETA.
Maria (SRE): Looking at telemetry — GPU utilization on zenit-3 jumped to 98% and queue depth climbed. KV cache miss rate increased ~x6 in the 20:45-21:05 window. Possibly heavy cold-start prompts.
Leo (platform): No recent infra deploys to that pool. Auto-scaler attempted to scale from 6->8 nodes but got capacity-scheduled failures in us-west-2. Reserved capacity quotas might be saturated.
Sam (oncall): Root checks: 1) Is this a model-level regen? 2) Is KV-cache fallback causing extra compute? 3) Any recent customer traffic spike? Maria can you post the query distribution?
Maria (SRE): Pasting quick top-k queries:
```
Top callers: zenit-prod: 72% of tokens
Seq len distribution skewed right, median 1024 -> P95 4096
KV cache hit rate dropped from 87% -> 14%
```
Maria (SRE): Looks like a sudden high-var prompt set causing many misses, increasing per-token work and saturating batch slots.
Kevin (DevEx): We have a temporary runbook for reserved pool saturation. Steps: 1) enable pool-burst 2) switch zenit traffic to compatible fallback model (quantized) 3) open PD incident + ping customer. I'll paste commands.
Kevin (DevEx): Command to enable burst capacity (trial):
```
rctl reserved update --pool zenit-3 --burst-enabled true --burst-add-nodes 2
```
Sam (oncall): Doing step 1 now. Running rctl... output: burst-add failed: capacity-not-available in us-west-2. :grimacing:
Leo (platform): Confirmed cloud quotas exhausted in region. We can either: a) reroute zenit to another region (higher latency), b) fallback to quantized model on same pool, c) evict low-priority workloads.
Sam (oncall): Start c) evict non-reserved lower-tier jobs from zenit-3, then enable quantized fallback. Maria, prepare the eviction range.
Maria (SRE): Eviction started for 'dev-sandbox' and 'batch-infer' workloads. Kicking jobs now. Queue depth reducing but still high.
Anya (CS - Zenit): Please keep Zenit in loop. If we shift region, they'll need cookie-sync and might see ~100-200ms extra latency.
Sam (oncall): Switching Zenit routes to quantized model variant (zenit-prod-q4) for degraded mode. Command:
```
route update zenit --model zenit-prod-q4 --force
```
Sam (oncall): Route update successful. New requests going to q4 quantized variant. Observing tail latency dropping from 1400ms -> 420ms within 2 minutes. 429 rate down from 3.4% -> 0.6%.
incident-bot: PD-8721 status changed: mitigation applied by Sam (oncall).
pagerduty: PD-8721: If condition persists > 20m, escalation to Ops Lead.
Leo (platform): Follow-up: Need a manual increase of reserved capacity quota in us-west-2. I'll open a cloud request and parallelly schedule an emergency capacity reassign. ETA for quota increase unknown (~hours).
Maria (SRE): Current action items: continue eviction until queue stabilizes, monitor KV cache repopulation, watch for cache surge causing transient load. Setting alert for KV-miss > 30%.
Sam (oncall): Contacting Zenit CS: Anya, summarizing: we detected pool saturation due to sudden KV misses causing high compute. We switched to quantized fallback and evicted non-reserved jobs; customer impact reduced. We may need tenant capacity bump.
Anya (CS - Zenit): Thanks. I'm telling them we're on degraded variant with lower latency and will follow up with postmortem. They asked for timeline to full restore.
Sam (oncall): Tentative timeline: if cloud quota increases within 2-4h, we can add nodes and revert to standard model. Otherwise propose a rolling plan to migrate to a multi-region pool.
Kevin (DevEx): I'll run a quick pressure test to validate fallback quality (small eval set) and post any regression flags to the console.
Maria (SRE): Monitoring shows KV cache warming — hit rate climbing to 46% and latency trending down. Keeping PD incident open until 30m stable.
Sam (oncall): Handoff note for next oncall (Leo) — watch PD-8721, watch KV-hit >50% and p95 latency <600ms. If >600ms and 429s increase, escalate to Ops Lead and consider cross-region switch.
Leo (platform): Ack. I'll take night watch at 22:00 UTC. Opening internal follow-up ticket: INT-zenit-2026 for capacity + quota + runbook improvements.
incident-bot: PD-8721 monitoring: 30m stability window started at 21:20 UTC.
Sam (oncall): Thanks team. Good job. Closing in-channel updates. :thumbsup:
Anya (CS - Zenit): Zenit thanked us for quick mitigation. Please include them on postmortem when ready.
pagerduty: PD-8721 remains open and assigned to Sam (oncall).
